description: This file contains the implementation of the DelayedSettlementAttributeService interface, specifically the DelayedSettlementAttributeServiceImpl class. It provides functionality to check whether the delayed settlement feature is enabled for a given loan product by retrieving and inspecting relevant attributes.

classes.name: DelayedSettlementAttributeServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of service to determine if delayed settlement is enabled for a loan product.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the delayed settlement attribute is enabled for a specific loan product ID by retrieving attribute data and comparing its value to the configured attribute value.
